Saffire-I sample I-1: a 40.6 cm wide, 0.37 mm cotton-fiberglass sheet in 20 cm/s concurrent flow at 21.5-21.7% O2 burned about 84 cm at 1.8 mm/s (Table 1). Saffire-I opposed-flow sample I-2 spread only about 10 cm, at 1.3 mm/s, over 70 s. On Saffire VI the Nomex fabric sample did not ignite.

The FLEX 'burning rate' is the average burning-rate constant from a linear fit of droplet diameter squared versus time; Table IX reports it in mm2/s (the PSI-69 column header says 'mm'). Both radiative extinction (larger droplets, higher dilution) and diffusive extinction (smaller droplets) were observed in FLEX.

The Apollo 204 board listed conditions that led to the disaster, including a sealed oxygen-pressurized cabin and extensive combustible materials. Investigators identified latex glove material introduced into the canister as the most likely cause of the Mir fire. Saffire IV-VI found the cabin temperature and pressure rise less significant than the increase in carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide.

SpaceXtinsafe does not give safety verdicts, fire-risk scores or emergency instructions. It can show what NASA research found for the materials and conditions you choose. For operational decisions, use the vehicle's authorised procedures and qualified fire-safety experts.

evaluation_kind: Internal: questions and labels written by the build assistant. Scoring is automatic (no human or LLM judge). Not an independent human evaluation.
disclosure: HOLDOUT-3. Written 2026-11-15 after the four fixes were coded but BEFORE they were run on any of these questions; hash-locked in eval/HOLDOUT3.lock. Questions come from library findings and from passages of the original NASA publications (source per question) not used in holdout-2. 'relevant' lists the curated findings that state the reference fact; an empty list means the fact is only in the publication, so the correct behaviour is to decline. Written by the build assistant, who knows the failure types the fixes address (value questions, attribute questions, conflict questions, 'paper' phrasing): the set deliberately contains such questions, so it tests whether the fixes generalise, but it is not an independent holdout.
